verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents AskFred, an in-product AI assistant that answers natural-language questions across one or many meetings with context-aware answers and follow-ups. It also generates notes, action items, customized summaries and conversation intelligence from meeting data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and explicit evidence of proactive suggestions beyond action items and summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
Maintain conversations where follow-up questions preserve context from previous exchanges
Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
